name: cempulse
description: CemPulse — Smart Cement Manufacturing Facility dashboard (React client + Express API)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.postinstall: npm run install:all && npm run build
